en: Antique German postcard with a whimsical illustration of tuxedo-wearing frogs by a pond framing an inset photograph of a forested restaurant. The inset is captioned 'Restauration z. kühlen Grund bei Jugenheim.' The reverse shows German and French postal headings, a red 10 Pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp, and a postmark reading 'Jugenheim Bergstrasse' dated 31.5.05, addressed to a recipient in Malmö.
